subject: Close accounting pass: Q4 commit + owner checklist
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Peter Collins <pcollins@acme.com>
Date: Mon, 27 Sep 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Close accounting pass: Q4 commit + owner checklist

Team / Peter —

We’re starting a focused accounting pass for Q4 commitments. I’ve attached the working commit matrix (Q4_commit_matrix_v3.xlsx). Please do the following by the times below so we can produce a consolidated rollup for Finance: 

- Update the "Owner" and "Stage" columns for any deals you own (deadline: EOD today, 27 Sep).
- For any deals with >60% probability that require PO or legal signoff, add the expected PO date in the "Commit (PO)" column.
- If you need a non-standard discount or credit, mark the row with RED and put approver name in the comment — Priya, Laura and I will triage.

Special ask for Acme: Peter, can you confirm the procurement timeline and whether your PO is expected this week or next? If there are internal approvals on your side we should mark them in the matrix.

I will compile the first rollup at 6pm PT today and a final pass at 6pm PT tomorrow (28 Sep). Thanks — short, actionable updates please.

Attachments: Q4_commit_matrix_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

Jonas Weber
Head of Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com | +1 (415) 555-0123

Subject: Re: Close accounting pass: Q4 commit + owner checklist

  - Probability: 75%
  - Commit (PO): Target 2027-09-29 (procurement routing, see note)
  - Notes: Legal requested one minor SLA tweak (2.1.b) — expecting confirmation today.

- Meridian Health (MDN-3102) — Stage: Final Approvals
  - Owner: Priya Natarajan
  - Probability: 60%
  - Commit (PO): 2027-10-02 (needs finance exec signoff)

- Raptor Analytics (RPT-201) — Stage: Negotiation
  - Owner: Laura Bennett
  - Probability: 40%
  - Commit (PO): TBD

Attached: acme_po_draft.pdf (attachment stub)

I'll flag the ACME row red if the SLA wrinkle isn't cleared by EOD. Priya, can you confirm whether we can approve the discount exception if Acme needs it (approx 8% requested)?

—David
Director, Commercial Finance | Redwood Inference

- Priya: confirm discount approver status (EOD today).
- Laura: update Raptor row and add expected timeline (EOD tomorrow).
- Jonas: I’ll produce the first consolidated rollup for Finance at 6pm PT today and the final rollup at 6pm PT tomorrow.
